notes: Evidence has no capacity, attendance, pricing, or seasonality figures; those rely on general knowledge of MLB operations.

recreation_entertainment_activity.value: Professional sports promotion (Atlanta Braves MLB club) plus The Battery Atlanta mixed-use real estate development next to Truist Park

venue_service_capacity.value: Truist Park, a major-league ballpark, plus CoolToday Park spring training complex and leasable retail, office, hotel and residential space at The Battery Atlanta

seasonality_utilization.value: Event-day-driven ballpark use during the baseball season, with spring training in Florida; Battery Atlanta offers year-round retail, office and residential use
